name: Commanding a Harem
source:
You were a commander of a powerful group that protects humanity but after being trapped in a memory eating creature's demesne, you are freed but half of your memories are gone. You decide to start a new life and command a new group. Travel and interact throughout the world, make new memories and regain your old ones.

[From [url=https://thomoto.itch.io/commandingaharem]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你曾是守护人类的强大组织的指挥官，但在被困于一头噬忆生物的领地后，虽得以脱困却失去了一半的记忆。你决定开启新的人生，率领一支新的队伍。在世界各地旅行并与人互动，创造全新回忆的同时找回你失去的过往吧。

[引自[url=https://thomoto.itch.io/commandingaharem]Itch.io[/url]]
